name.ja: ハロプラ 黒い三連ハロ[クリアカラー]

description.ja: 内部構造まで再現しながらも簡単に組み合てられるハロプラから、黒い三連星仕様のハロがクリアカラーになって登場！
description.en: From Haropura, which reproduces the internal structure and can be easily assembled, the black triple star halo is now available in clear color!

description.ja: • 耳は開閉し、手足は差し替えで再現！
description.en: • The ears can be opened and closed, and the limbs can be recreated by replacing them!

description.ja: • 他のハロプラやプチッガイとの連結が可能！
description.en: • Can be connected with other Haropla and Petitgguy!

description.ja: • 余剰パーツは台座に収納可能！
description.en: • Surplus parts can be stored on the pedestal!

description.ja: • ３機分のナンバーを再現できるホイルシールが付属！
description.en: • Comes with foil seals that can reproduce the numbers of 3 aircraft!
